Greek River, Lot 63, Kings, Prince Edward Island, Canada

notes: CORRECTIONS (workflow, 2026-07-03): birthplace likely Mount Albion/Birch Hill, Lot 49 (not Vernon River, Lot 49 as tree has it — Vernon River was where his great-grandfather Nicolaus Henckell first settled, probably conflated forward). Father's middle name 'Holland' (as in 'George Holland Jenkins') is unsourced — sources call him simply George Jenkins (d. 1836). The tree's 'Maragaret Acorn Eachorn' is a garbled merge of Margaret Acorn and her father's original surname Eichorn (anglicized to Acorn), not a separate person — do not treat as two people.
